articles.summary: San Rafael, CA: The Board of Directors of Westamerica Bancorporation (NASDAQ: WABC) today approved a plan to repurchase, as conditions warrant, up to 2,000,000 shares of the Company’s common stock on the open market or in privately negotiated transactions prior to December 31, 2026.
